literature.title: Calcium-sensing Receptor, a Potential Biomarker Revealed by Large-scale Public Databases and Experimental Verification in Metastatic Breast Cancer.
literature.abstract: Breast cancer (BC) is a common cancer characterized by a high molecular heterogeneity. Therefore, understanding its biological properties and developing effective treatments for patients with different molecular features is imperative. Calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR) has been implicated in several regulatory functions in various types of human cancers. However, its underlying pathological mechanism in BC progression remains elusive.

literature.abstract: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) in the most common and earliest manifestation of multiple endocrine neoplasia type-1 (MEN1). Epidemiological data have been reported in MEN1 patients but data on long-term follow-up focusing on PHPT are scarce.

literature.title: Impact of cinacalcet hydrochloride in clinical management of primary hyperparathyroidism in multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1.
literature.abstract: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) is one of main cause of morbidity in patients with multiple endocrine neoplasia type 1 (MEN1). Medical therapy with cinacalcet-hydrochloride may modify the therapeutic strategy of MEN1 related PHPT. We present an experience with cinacalcet-hydrochloride in two patients with MEN1 PHPT.

literature.title: Off-label use of cinacalcet in pediatric primary hyperparathyroidism: A French multicenter experience.
literature.abstract: Cinacalcet is a calcimimetic approved in adults with primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT). Few cases reports described its use in pediatric HPT, with challenges related to the risk of hypocalcemia, increased QT interval and drug interactions. In this study, we report the French experience in this setting.

literature.abstract: Acrodysostosis is a rare skeletal dysplasia with one gene mutation associated with pseudohypoparathyroidism. We describe a 15-year-old male patient with genetic acrodysostosis who presented with hyperparathyroidism.

literature.abstract: Primary hyperparathyroidism (PHPT) is a challenging problem in type 1 multiple endocrine neoplasia (MEN1) due to the high postsurgery recurrence rate. authors: van den Berk Sandra A M
literature.abstract: Several reports have shown good performance of fluorine-18 fluorocholine (F-FCH) PET-computed tomography (CT) for parathyroid localization, although overall evidence remains scarce. We collected data from three institutions in the Netherlands and investigated the performance of F-FCH PET-CT as a second-line imaging modality.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: MEN1（多發性內分泌腫瘤第一型）以原發性副甲狀腺機能亢進症（PHPT）為最常見表現（約 95% 患者）。Cinacalcet 透過活化副甲狀腺 CaSR，降低 PTH 閾值分泌點，有效控制高鈣血症。雖無法縮小腫瘤，但可作為手術前橋接治療或手術不適合者的長期管理選項。多項獨立佇列研究證實 MEN1 相關 PHPT 患者的臨床效益，法國多中心研究亦支持兒科族群 off-label 使用。
理論假說：CaSR 表達於三叉神經節，其活化可能影響 CGRP（降鈣素基因相關肽）釋放，而 CGRP 為偏頭痛關鍵調節因子。然而此推論缺乏實驗驗證，現有零臨床或臨床前證據，不足以支持進一步評估。
三叉自主神經頭痛（TAC，含叢集性頭痛）涉及三叉神經-副交感神經反射弧活化。CaSR-CGRP 假說與 headache disorder 相同，但特異性更低。無任何臨床或臨床前支持資料。
多毛症主要由雄激素過多或毛囊對雄激素的感受性異常引起。CaSR 在毛囊生長調節中的角色無文獻支持。TxGNN 預測可能為圖模型的偽關聯，無生物學合理性。

literature.abstract: Calcimimetics act as positive allosteric modulators of the calcium-sensing receptor (CaSR), thereby decreasing parathyroid hormone (PTH) secretion from the parathyroid glands. On the other hand, negative allosteric modulators of the CaSR with stimulatory effect on PTH secretion are termed calcilytics.
